issues.legal_issue: A declaration fixing a taluqdar’s jama is distinct from a settlement of land revenue and does not continue under the land-revenue settlement rule until a revised settlement is introduced.
material_facts: A revenue settlement fixed the assessment of the lands comprising the estates and recorded the assessment of individual survey numbers.
The government separately fixed a lower jama, calculated by reference to the aggregate survey assessments, for a limited term.
The landholders challenged demands for the full land revenue assessment after that term, contending that the jama declaration continued until a revised settlement.
issues.conclusion: The jama declaration was not a settlement of land revenue within the meaning of the rule that kept existing land-revenue settlements in force until a revised settlement; the contention that it continued on that basis failed.
issues.legal_principle: Under sections 117C(1), 117D and 117R of the Bombay Land Revenue Code, a land-revenue settlement is the result of prescribed operations to determine assessment, including assessment of lands by groups and individual survey numbers; an existing settlement of that kind continues until a revised settlement. Sections 4 and 5 of the Gujarat Taluqdars Act provided for survey and assessment, while sections 22 and 23 dealt separately with fixing or agreeing the jama payable by a taluqdar. Though based on survey assessments, jama was distinct from the land-revenue assessment and its fixing was not a settlement of land revenue. No earlier cases were relied on.

predicates.challenge_to_enhanced_land_revenue_deman: A landholder challenged a demand for land revenue exceeding the amount previously payable.
predicates.separate_jama_fixed_for_limited_term: The government fixed a separate jama payable by the landholder for a limited term, based on aggregate survey assessments.
predicates.land_assessment_recorded_for_individual_: A survey settlement recorded land-revenue assessments for individual plots.

issues.definition: When a landholder challenges an enhanced revenue demand after a limited-term jama was fixed separately from individual land assessments, the jama declaration does not continue merely until a revised land-revenue settlement.

issues.legal_issue: After a saved jama declaration expires, a former taluqdar who has become an occupant is liable for the full land-revenue assessment.
material_facts: The tenure was abolished and the former taluqdars became occupants of the lands, which were liable to land revenue under the general land-revenue law.
The abolition law preserved the right to pay only jama under a declaration or settlement only while it remained in force.
The jama declarations had a limited term, which expired before the enhanced revenue demands were made.
The settlement registers recorded the full land-revenue assessments for the lands.
issues.conclusion: The saved declarations protected payment of jama only until their terms expired; after expiry, the former taluqdars were liable for the full land-revenue assessment according to the settlement registers.
issues.legal_principle: Sections 3 and 5(1) of the Bombay Taluqdari Tenure Abolition Act abolished the tenure, made the lands liable to land revenue under the Code and treated the former taluqdars as occupants. Section 5(2)(b) preserved the right to pay only jama under a recognized settlement or declaration only so long as it remained in force; section 17 preserved declarations and settlements from the effect of repeal. Sections 22 and 23 of the Gujarat Taluqdars Act provided for the declarations and settlements whose limited-term benefit was saved. No earlier cases were relied on.

rule.if: challenge_to_enhanced_land_revenue_demand and former_tenure_abolished and former_holder_became_occupant and jama_declaration_term_expired and full_land_assessment_recorded

predicates.challenge_to_enhanced_land_revenue_deman: A landholder challenged a demand for land revenue exceeding the amount previously payable.
predicates.former_tenure_abolished: The special tenure under which the land was held was abolished.
predicates.former_holder_became_occupant: The former tenure-holder became an occupant of the land.
predicates.jama_declaration_term_expired: The declaration allowing payment of only jama had reached the end of its stated term.
predicates.full_land_assessment_recorded: A settlement register recorded the full land-revenue assessment for the land.

issues.definition: When a former tenure-holder who became an occupant challenges an enhanced demand after the limited-term jama declaration has expired, the occupant is liable for the full recorded land assessment.
